requirements.requirement_text: Film Shot creation MUST reject `fps.num <= 0`, `fps.den <= 0`, zero/negative duration, overflow/unsafe 53-bit JSON integers and noncanonical rational values; an FPS conversion is not an elapsed-time conversion. Persist source VFR PTS in a stable rational source clock and an explicit mapping for *every* output frame; for canonical fixed-FPS output use `frameTime = (frameIndex * fps.den) / fps.num` with exact integer rational arithmetic. If production needs integer values outside JavaScript safe range, encode signed 64-bit numerator/denominator as decimal strings under a *separate* approved schema version: do not silently round. `durationFrames * fps.den / fps.num` defines video duration only; source-time mapping can differ by retime.

A 23.976 fps VFR source with 44.1 kHz audio, 48 kHz final mix and a vertical variant with different shot cuts is a mandatory fixture.
